blocks.x: I'll make a note on here first that we're interviewing Mr. Andrew Morgan over at the record store 731 St. Peter and this is Bill Russell and the date is July the 4th, the holiday, 1961. Could you give your full name? Do you have a middle name?
No, my name is Andrew Morgan.
